name: Datum
summary: The private side of a flagship showroom: one car at a time, shown in detail at night, the facts handed over calmly. A damson ground with its silver-lilac bloom as the one accent (thin underlines, the datum mark, the key in the handover, never a filled button); Red Hat Display only, light and large for lines, 600 for model names; a 12-column grid of hairlines, square edges, no cards or shadows. The hero is one car in detail at night; the fleet comes in classes, one leading with three cars and their rules, the rest as a quiet rail and a range strip. For performance and luxury hire firms.
